# ui::ThreadCheckFailure

Header: `winui/core/ThreadCheck.hpp`.

One wrong-thread call, handed to the thread check handler.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `std::string` |  | The whole report, e.g. "ui::TextControl::set_text called on thread 1234, but the tree belongs to thread 5678 (Text.cpp:41)". |
| `call` | `std::string` |  | The offending call, e.g. "ui::TextControl::set_text" or "ui::Property::set". |
| `where` | `std::source_location` |  | Where it was made: inside the setter for an element, at the caller for [Property::set()](property.md#set). |
| `thread` | `std::thread::id` |  | The thread that made it. |
| `owner` | `std::thread::id` |  | The thread the tree or property belongs to. |
